headlines.description: — Mats Zuccarello scored 1:47 into overtime to lead the Minnesota Wild to a 5-4 win over the Buffalo Sabres at KeyBank Center on Saturday afternoon.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mats Zuccarello's overtime goal gives the Wild a 5-4 win over the red-hot Sabres

events.name: New York Rangers at Philadelphia Flyers

headlines.description: — Mika Zibanejad became the Rangers' all-time leader in power-play goals and his three-goal performance tied the team record for most career hat tricks in New York's 6-3 win over the Philadelphia Flyers on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Zibanejad sets Rangers' record for power-play goals, ties team hat trick record in win over Flyers

events.name: New York Islanders at Calgary Flames

headlines.description: — Adam Klapka had a goal and an assist for his first multi-point game of the season as the Calgary Flames beat the New York Islanders 4-2 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Klapka's goal and assist help power the Flames to a 4-2 win over the Islanders

headlines.description: — Nate Schmidt scored two goals and assisted on two others to lead the Utah Mammoth to a 6-3 victory over the Seattle Kraken on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nate Schmidt scores twice to help Mammoth beat Kraken 6-3

headlines.description: — Montreal scored three straight goals, including Cole Caufield’s second of the game 33 seconds into overtime, to give the Canadiens a 6-5 come-from-behind win over the Ottawa Senators on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Caufield scores in OT as Canadiens beat Senators 6-5

events.name: Carolina Hurricanes at New Jersey Devils

headlines.description: — Andrei Svechnikov had a hat trick and Frederik Andersen made 28 saves as the Carolina Hurricanes beat the New Jersey Devils 4-1 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Svechnikov has a hat trick to lead Hurricanes to 4-1 win over Devils

events.name: Columbus Blue Jackets at Pittsburgh Penguins

headlines.description: — Charlie Coyle scored the deciding goal in the shootout and the Columbus Blue Jackets beat the Pittsburgh Penguins 4-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Coyle scores shootout winner as Blue Jackets beat Penguins 4-3

headlines.description: — Sam Bennett had a goal and two assists, and the Florida Panthers rebounded from a lopsided loss at Carolina with a 5-2 victory over the Washington Capitals on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Panthers rebound from an 8-goal loss to Carolina, beat Capitals 5-2 in Washington

events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at Winnipeg Jets

headlines.description: — Max Domi scored at 3:08 of overtime on a 2-on-1 with Auston Matthews to lift the Toronto Maple Leafs past the Winnipeg Jets, 4-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Max Domi scores in overtime to cap Maple Leafs' rally in 4-3 win over Jets

headlines.description: — Mason Lohrei scored two goals and the Boston Bruins beat the Chicago Blackhawks 5-2 on Saturday night to extend their winning streak to six games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bruins beat Blackhawks 5-2, extend winning streak to six games

headlines.description: — Tristan Jarry made 31 saves for his first shutout for Edmonton, Jack Roslovic and Kasperi Kapanen each scored twice and the Oilers routed the Vancouver Canucks 6-0 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jarry makes 31 saves in Oilers' 6-0 victory as Canucks drop 10th straight

events.name: Nashville Predators at Vegas Golden Knights

headlines.description: — Alexander Holtz and Shea Theodore scored in a 1:05 span late in the second period and the Vegas Golden Knights had two more two-goal sprees to rout the Nashville Predators 7-1 on Saturday night for their seventh straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Golden Knights rout Predators 7-2 for their 7th straight victory

events.name: Los Angeles Kings at Anaheim Ducks

headlines.description: — Mikael Granlund scored at 4:02 of overtime, and the Anaheim Ducks beat the Los Angeles Kings 2-1 on Saturday night to sweep a two-game weekend set...
headlines.shortLinkText: Beckett Sennecke sets up Mikael Granlund in OT, Ducks beat Kings 2-1 for weekend sweep
